game.title: Los Angeles Rams at Las Vegas Raiders

lede: Los Angeles Rams carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#5 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Las Vegas Raiders +3.0 with a fair total of 49.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Rams pass offence vs Las Vegas Raiders pass defence, which sits +0.195 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
